objective: Harden ordinary teaching invite-code operations so unsafe target class identifiers are rejected at the route boundary before external course-management reads or operation-ledger writes.

codeReferences.summary: The teaching operations POST route now validates invite-code target class ids immediately after operation/action parsing.
The route-level target class guard rejects unsafe targetClassId/classId values with a redacted 400 response.
Regression proves unsafe invite-code target class ids do not trigger external course-management reads or operation appends.

securityPosture.ordinaryTeachingRoute: Invite-code operations now reject unsafe target class ids before class ownership preflight, external course-management reads, or operation-ledger appends.
securityPosture.rbacBoundary: Course ownership authorization still runs before invite target validation, and unsafe target class ids are denied before class-scope storage access.
securityPosture.redaction: The unsafe path-like target class id, storage token, external origin, and local data directory are not echoed in the response.
securityPosture.productionPersistence: The regression uses production-style external storage configuration and proves no external course-management request is made for the unsafe target class id.

aggregateEnterpriseGateImpact.summary: This closes a narrow ordinary teaching RBAC/storage boundary gap in the invite-code class-target path. The full enterprise gate still requires same-run owner-approved production evidence for env placement, deployment, storage, ordinary teaching route/browser smokes, app-auth readiness, browser workflow smoke, and live provider generation.
